L1 | Panjang Diagonal = sqrt((sqrt180)^2 + (sqrt80)^2)
L2 | (sqrt180)^2 = 180   (sqrt80)^2 = 80
L3 | sqrt(180 + 80) = sqrt260
L4 | sqrt260 = sqrt(4x65) = sqrt4 x sqrt65 = 2sqrt65 meter
L5 | 260 = 4 x 65
L6 | Hasil akhir 26 meter
reasoning: 2sqrt65 m is reached correctly, but the final line states 26 m, an unexplained wrong value replacing the correct simplest form.
The proportion 100x = 360 x 15 is correct, but 360 x 15 is computed as 5600 instead of 5400, giving 56 instead of 54.
The student splits sqrt(a + b) as sqrt a + b (e.g. 3sqrt(9+2) = 3.3 + 2), so all three lengths are wrong; correct values 3sqrt11 ≈ 9,95, 4sqrt5 ≈ 8,94, 2sqrt17 ≈ 8,25 all qualify.
